Hi Priya - thanks for the clear asks. Apologies for the slight delay; responses below and attached artifacts. High-priority items first:

1) SOC 2 status:
- Redwood has SOC 2 Type I (controls design) completed for our serving runtime; SOC 2 Type II is currently in progress with expected availability Q3 2026.
- Attached: Redwood_SOC2_Summary_Q12026.pdf (summary of scope and lead auditor). Full Type II report will be shared under NDA / once finalized.

2) HIPAA / BAA:
- We support HIPAA-covered workloads and can execute a Business Associate Agreement. We do not require a signed BAA before returning the completed SIG, but will generally request one before going into a production environment that processes PHI. If you need the BAA executed earlier, we can route a draft via DocuSign.
- Draft BAA link (internal): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/to/BAA-draft

3) Encryption & Key Management:
- Encryption at rest: AES-256 (FIPS 140-2 validated where applicable).
- Encryption in transit: TLS 1.2+ (recommended TLS 1.3).
- Customer-managed keys: supported via AWS KMS; customer HSM support available for Private deployments.

4) Data residency / region routing:
- For Dedicated and Private customers we can commit to region-level routing. For hosted customers we offer region pinning for production tenants (US, EU) - please flag account as US production in provisioning notes.

5) Next steps / timeline:
- We will complete the SIG spreadsheet and return it as "Redwood_SIG_Response_ACME_2026.xlsx" within 48 hours.
- We can execute a BAA either before or after SIG completion based on your procurement needs (let us know preference).
- If useful, schedule a 30-min technical security deep-dive with our infra/security lead (Dev Patel) - available Wed/Thu this week.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary_Q12026.pdf, Redwood_SIG_Response_ACME_2026.xlsx

Let me know if you want us to mark specific SIG rows as high-priority for evidence collection.

Thanks and looking forward to moving this forward quickly.
